name: Leuphana University Luneburg
summary: Public university in Lüneburg; seven English-taught majors in its College, each studied with a minor, with no tuition fees.

ib.text: The IB must meet Germany's KMK rule on subjects and grades. Places are ranked on grades plus experience and achievements. English: IB English A HL at 6, an English-medium school, or e.g. IELTS 6.5.

apply.via: Leuphana's myCampus portal (EU/EEA citizens apply directly)

dates.label: Application deadline for winter semester 2027/28 (window opens mid-May)

programmes.name: Cultural Studies: Organization, Society, and the Arts
Studium Individuale
programmes.ib: Core modules are in English, but Leuphana warns that some modules may require German.

notes: You combine your major with a minor; several minors are in English, and for a German-taught minor you should ideally have C1 German (DSH-2).
All seven English majors have capped places, from 35 in Cultural Studies to 160 in International Business Administration & Entrepreneurship.
Around half of Digital Media's courses take place at the Hamburg Media School, the other half on the Lüneburg campus.
